title: Kid Howard at the Caledonia shows
summary: He sat in for drummer Edgar Mosby at the Caledonia floor shows and lists the entertainers.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Yeah, because Howard was playing nightly at the, what they call it, the Caledonia, with the Japanese T-Guard. I used to go around that night and when I was big enough I was big for my age. And I used to go hang up there and listen at them play at night. Followed by the name of Edgar Mosby. And he used to tell me, could I sit down and play with me? I said, I can't play with him. He said, sit down. Well Howard called me, cuz. He said, cuz sit down. I said, the only way you gonna learn is sit down and play with them. But I couldn't play the shows. When time come for the flow show while Edgar come in, he'd sit down and play the show. I sit down and play his whole job for him. Didn't get a nickel for it. But I just wanted to be playing, learn how to play. What kind of shows did they have? What happened? Well they had four shows. They were like, this guy by the name of Memphis.
He was the entertainer. He was a comedian around there. Myrtle Jones, she was the blues singer around there.

And little Sammy Hopkins, he used to sing with the show. Followed by the name of Ferdinand Johnson was the master ceremony around there. Did they have any dancers? Well yeah, I used to have dance there after the show. No, no. I mean in the show. Did they have anybody doing any special kind of dancing in the show? Yeah. I'm trying to think who the followers was.
